data.narrative:
Eden Geopower is a Seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Paris Smalls and Ammar Alali that has raised $19.8M to date. The comparable universe in Climate & Energy includes one public company and eight private peers, though narrow peer filtering (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation tier) did not yield sufficient datapoints for median-based valuation.

Stage-progression analysis is the applicable triangulation method here. Using total capital raised of $19.8M as a proxy for Seed-stage valuation and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier to the next funding stage yields an implied valuation of $49.5M. This multiplier reflects observed progression patterns from Seed to Series A rounds within the climate tech sector.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $42M to $57M, centered at $50M. The low end reflects conservative step-up assumptions, while the high end incorporates upside scenarios. Key uncertainties limiting precision include the absence of direct Seed-stage comparables in the narrow Climate & Energy peer set and reliance on a single methodological input. Investor due diligence should prioritize unit economics validation, technology differentiation relative to the broader peer cohort, and market adoption trajectory to substantiate positioning within this range.
